description:
This Swift source file defines a GatewayConnection class for managing WebSocket-based communication with a server, including request handling, subscriber management, and specific API functions for chat, system events, health, skills, sessions, voice wake, node and device pairing, and cron jobs.
It contains enums, structs, and a singleton actor to encapsulate connection state and methods.

classes.name: GatewayConnection
classes.description: An actor singleton class managing a web socket connection to the gateway, providing request methods, subscription handling, and API calls for various functionalities like chat, health checks, skill management, session previews, voice wake triggers, pairing, and cron jobs.

methods.name: request
methods.description: Perform an API request with specified method and parameters, with retries in case of errors depending on mode.

methods.name: requestRaw
methods.description: Send a raw request with specified method, parameters, and optional timeout; returns raw Data.

methods.name: requestDecoded
methods.description: Send a request and decode the response into a Decodable type.

methods.name: requestVoid
methods.description: Send a request expecting no return value (void).

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Reconfigure the underlying socket connection.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Subscribe to gateway pushes, returning an AsyncStream of GatewayPush events.

methods.name: sendAgent
methods.description: Send a message via agent with detailed invocation data.

methods.name: sendAgent (overload)
methods.description: Convenience method to send an agent message with specific parameters.

methods.name: sendSystemEvent
methods.description: Send a system event with given parameters.

methods.name: healthSnapshot
methods.description: Retrieve a health snapshot from the gateway.

methods.name: healthOK
methods.description: Check if the gateway health is OK, optionally with a custom timeout.

methods.name: skillsStatus
methods.description: Query the status of installed skills.

methods.name: skillsInstall
methods.description: Install a skill by name with parameters like install ID and force flag.

methods.name: skillsUpdate
methods.description: Update a skill with key and settings such as enable/disable, API key, environment.

methods.name: sessionsPreview
methods.description: Get a preview of sessions based on keys with optional limits.

methods.name: chatHistory
methods.description: Fetch chat history for a session key, with limits.

methods.name: chatSend
methods.description: Send a chat message with optional attachments.

methods.name: chatAbort
methods.description: Abort a chat session run.

methods.name: talkMode
methods.description: Enable or disable talk mode, optionally setting phase.

methods.name: voiceWakeGetTriggers
methods.description: Retrieve voice wake triggers.

methods.name: voiceWakeSetTriggers
methods.description: Set voice wake triggers.

methods.name: nodePairApprove
methods.description: Approve a node pairing request.

methods.name: nodePairReject
methods.description: Reject a node pairing request.

methods.name: devicePairApprove
methods.description: Approve a device pairing request.

methods.name: devicePairReject
methods.description: Reject a device pairing request.

methods.name: cronStatus
methods.description: Get the status of the cron scheduler.

methods.name: cronList
methods.description: List all cron jobs, optionally including disabled.

methods.name: cronRuns
methods.description: Retrieve log entries of cron runs for a job.

methods.name: cronRun
methods.description: Force run a cron job.

methods.name: cronRemove
methods.description: Remove a cron job.

methods.name: cronUpdate
methods.description: Update a cron job with patch.

methods.name: cronAdd
methods.description: Add a new cron job with payload.
